functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.assign_new_client()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF new.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Client owner mismatch' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.coach_client_assignments(coach_id,client_id)
    VALUES(new.coach_id,new.id);
  RETURN new;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.basic_is_coach()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=p.id
    JOIN private.coach_allowlist a ON a.email=lower(u.email)
    WHERE p.id=auth.uid() AND p.role='coach' AND u.email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.basic_owner_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF new.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM old.coach_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Client owner is immutable' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN new;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_manage_client(p_client_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT private.basic_is_coach() AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.clients c WHERE c.id=p_client_id AND c.coach_id=auth.uid()
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_see_profile(p_id uuid, p_client_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT p_id=auth.uid() OR
   (p_client_id IS NOT NULL AND private.can_manage_client(p_client_id));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.email_key(e text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when split_part(lower(trim(e)), '@', 2) in ('gmail.com', 'googlemail.com')
      then replace(split_part(split_part(lower(trim(e)), '@', 1), '+', 1), '.', '') || '@gmail.com'
    else lower(trim(e))
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.guard_posture_frozen()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF old.assessment_id <> 'draft' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Historical posture report is immutable'; END IF;
 RETURN new;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_profile()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from public.profiles where id = auth.uid());
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_coach()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT private.basic_is_coach(); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.my_client_id()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT p.client_id FROM public.profiles p
 JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=p.id
 JOIN public.clients c ON c.id=p.client_id
 WHERE p.id=auth.uid() AND p.role='client'
 AND lower(c.email)=lower(u.email) AND u.email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.on_auth_user_created()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform private.link_user(new.id, new.email, new.raw_user_meta_data->>'display_name');
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.on_client_referral_match()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.email <> '' then
    update public.referrals
    set status = 'signed_up', referred_client_id = new.id, updated_at = now()
    where lower(email) = lower(new.email) and status = 'invited';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cron_secret_ok(s text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'cron_secret' and decrypted_secret = s);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_existing_signup_account(p_email text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth.users u WHERE lower(u.email) = lower(trim(p_email)));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pf_head_coach()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=p.id
 JOIN private.settings s ON s.key='coach_email' AND lower(s.value)=lower(u.email)
 WHERE p.id=auth.uid() AND p.role='coach' AND u.email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pf_list_trainers()
 RETURNS TABLE(email text, coach_id uuid, display_name text, verified boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.pf_head_coach() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Head coach only' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT a.email,p.id,coalesce(p.display_name,''),u.email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
 FROM private.coach_allowlist a LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON lower(u.email)=a.email
 LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id=u.id AND p.role='coach'
 ORDER BY a.email;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pf_trainer_is_allowed(p_email text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT public.pf_head_coach() AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.coach_allowlist WHERE email=lower(trim(p_email)));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.referral_credit_amount()
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(nullif(value, '')::numeric, 0) from private.settings where key = 'referral_credit';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.referral_inviter(p_code text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select split_part(coalesce(c.data->>'name', ''), ' ', 1)
  from public.referral_codes r join public.clients c on c.id = r.client_id
  where r.code = lower(trim(p_code));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.signup_role(p_email text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE
  WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM private.coach_allowlist a WHERE a.email=lower(trim(p_email))) THEN 'coach'
  WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.clients c WHERE c.email<>'' AND lower(c.email)=lower(trim(p_email))) THEN 'client'
  ELSE NULL
 END;
$function$
